Cv Missing.questionText: Let’s talk about your work journey! Can you list 3–5 roles you've held – even internships or freelance gigs count!
Got any tech tools or platforms you work with regularly? Feel free to name them – software, languages, anything!
Which soft skills come naturally to you — like how you communicate, solve problems, or support your team?
Have you done any certifications, courses, or attended workshops recently?
If you’re comfortable sharing, what’s your current or expected salary range? Totally okay to skip if you’d rather not say!
Have you worked on any cool projects (college, work, or side projects) that you’d love to share? Big or small – all count!
What languages can you speak, read, or write? Let me know your level — like fluent, basic, or somewhere in between.
If you had to describe yourself in your current career — like what you do, what drives you, and what kind of work excites you — how would you put it in a few lines?
